title: Zoho Books Sri Lanka VAT & SSCL Setup: Complete 2026 IRD Tax Guide
description: Comprehensive IRD tax compliance setup, custom tax rates, withholding taxes, automated tax returns, and digital invoice generation for Sri Lankan businesses.
author: PW Holdings Senior ERP Consultants
headline: Mastering Sri Lanka VAT (18%) and SSCL (2.5%) in Zoho Books

sections.heading: Inland Revenue Department (IRD) Compliance Requirements
sections.content: Operating a business in Sri Lanka requires strict adherence to Inland Revenue Department (IRD) regulations. With Value Added Tax (VAT) standing at 18% and the Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) at 2.5%, improper tax accounting can result in severe penalties and cash flow disruption. Zoho Books provides dedicated tax localization configured by PW Holdings to automate calculations at point of sale.

sections.heading: Configuring Tax Rates & Compound Calculations
sections.content: In Sri Lanka, SSCL is calculated on the liable turnover, followed by VAT on the combined value in specific industries. Inside Zoho Books, we set up hierarchical tax groups, automated exemption categories for export revenue, and digital tax invoices containing the mandatory Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration numbers.

sections.heading: Automating RAMIS Returns & Financial Statements
sections.content: At the close of every tax period, Zoho Books generates detailed VAT and SSCL summary reports compatible with the Revenue Administration Management Information System (RAMIS). This eliminates manual spreadsheets, shortens audit preparation time, and gives CFOs full visibility into input and output tax positions.

faq.q: Does Zoho Books calculate Sri Lanka VAT and SSCL automatically?
faq.a: Yes. When set up by PW Holdings, Zoho Books automatically applies 18% VAT and 2.5% SSCL on invoices, handles exempt goods, and prints legally compliant IRD tax invoices.

faq.q: Can Zoho Books generate RAMIS tax return summaries?
faq.a: Yes, Zoho Books produces detailed tax summary schedules matching Inland Revenue Department (IRD) filing categories.

title: Zoho One vs SAP vs ERPNext: Best ERP for Sri Lankan SMEs in 2026

sections.heading: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) & Licensing Breakdown
sections.content: Traditional ERP solutions like SAP Business One and Microsoft Dynamics require steep upfront software licensing fees, costly dedicated on-premise hardware, and expensive annual maintenance contracts (AMC). In contrast, Zoho One provides access to over 45+ enterprise applications—including Books, CRM, Desk, People, and Analytics—under a single, highly cost-effective subscription priced for emerging markets.

sections.heading: Implementation Timelines: Weeks vs Months
sections.content: Legacy ERP deployments in Sri Lanka often extend from 6 to 18 months, leading to project fatigue and budget overruns. With PW Holdings' rapid agile deployment methodology, mid-market companies can transition their core financials, sales pipelines, and inventory to Zoho within 4 to 8 weeks with zero business disruption.

sections.heading: Local Sri Lankan Partner Support & Customization
sections.content: Open-source solutions like ERPNext offer flexibility but lack guaranteed local enterprise SLA support and out-of-the-box mobile applications. Zoho One combines the robust security of enterprise-grade cloud architecture with low-code customization via Zoho Creator and dedicated on-site support from PW Holdings in Colombo.

faq.q: How much does Zoho One cost compared to SAP in Sri Lanka?
faq.a: Zoho One typically reduces total cost of ownership (TCO) by 60% to 75% compared to SAP Business One, eliminating high server infrastructure costs and steep annual maintenance fees.

faq.q: Can Zoho One handle manufacturing and supply chain workflows?
faq.a: Yes. Zoho One includes Zoho Inventory, Zoho Creator, and Zoho Flow, allowing full tracking of multi-stage bills of materials (BOM), batch tracking, and warehouse automation.

title: How to Configure Sri Lanka EPF, ETF & APIT in Zoho Payroll
description: Automate monthly salary slips, statutory employer contributions, C-Form generation, and direct bank salary transfers in Sri Lanka.
author: PW Holdings HR Tech Practice
headline: Complete Payroll Automation: EPF, ETF, APIT, and Labor Compliance in Sri Lanka

sections.heading: Statutory Sri Lankan Deductions: EPF, ETF & APIT
sections.content: Sri Lankan labor legislation mandates Employee Provident Fund (EPF) deductions of 8% from employee earnings, matched by a 12% employer contribution, alongside a 3% Employee Trust Fund (ETF) employer contribution. Additionally, the Advance Personal Income Tax (APIT) progressive tax brackets require precise monthly withholdings.

sections.heading: Automating Direct Bank Payments & C-Form Generation
sections.content: Managing payroll on spreadsheets risks calculation errors and delayed statutory submissions. Zoho Payroll automates statutory deductions, generates bank payment text files for direct upload to leading Sri Lankan banks (Commercial Bank, HNB, Sampath, Nations Trust), and prepares official EPF C-Forms with zero manual calculation.

sections.heading: Employee Self-Service & Secure Digital Payslips
sections.content: Through the Zoho Payroll mobile portal, staff members can view monthly pay stubs, check tax deduction summaries, submit reimbursement claims, and manage leave balances, reducing administrative HR overhead by up to 70%.

faq.q: Does Zoho Payroll support Sri Lanka EPF (12%+8%) and ETF (3%)?
faq.a: Yes, Zoho Payroll automatically calculates EPF (8% employee, 12% employer) and ETF (3% employer) based on total earnings in accordance with Sri Lankan Department of Labour rules.

faq.q: Can employees view payslips on their mobile phones?
faq.a: Yes. Zoho Payroll provides a dedicated self-service mobile app on iOS and Android where employees can download password-protected payslips and submit expense claims.

title: Migrating from Tally / QuickBooks Desktop to Zoho Books Cloud
description: Zero-downtime data migration checklist for chart of accounts, outstanding customer balances, vendor ledgers, and opening stock quantities in Sri Lanka.
author: PW Holdings Data Migration Specialists
headline: Zero-Downtime Migration from Tally & QuickBooks to Zoho Books Cloud Accounting

sections.heading: The Limitations of Desktop Accounting Systems in 2026
sections.content: Legacy desktop tools like Tally Prime and QuickBooks Desktop tie accounting data to physical office PCs, lack real-time multi-branch visibility, require manual backups vulnerable to ransomware, and cannot seamlessly integrate with e-commerce or modern bank feeds in Sri Lanka.

sections.heading: The 4-Step Zero-Downtime Migration Framework
sections.content: PW Holdings utilizes a proven migration framework: 1) Chart of Accounts cleanup and mapping; 2) Master data validation (Customers, Suppliers, Items); 3) Opening balance cutoff and historical trial balance reconciliation; 4) Parallel run and user training before official Go-Live.

sections.heading: Multi-Branch & Cloud Access Advantages
sections.content: Post-migration, directors and accountants access real-time financial dashboards from any device or mobile phone. Direct bank statement synchronization, automatic payment reminders, and multi-location warehouse tracking are activated immediately.

faq.q: Will my past accounting history be lost when migrating to Zoho Books?
faq.a: No. PW Holdings migrates complete customer ledgers, supplier balances, opening stock, and trial balances with full financial reconciliation.

faq.q: How long does a standard Tally to Zoho Books migration take?
faq.a: A standard migration typically takes 5 to 10 business days depending on the volume of inventory items and historical ledger complexity.

title: Automating Multi-Branch Stock Transfers & Re-Order Points with Zoho
description: Real-time barcode scanning, batch tracking with expiry dates, and automated PO generation across warehouse hubs in Sri Lanka.
author: PW Holdings Supply Chain Practice
headline: Multi-Warehouse Inventory Control: Barcode Scanning, Batch Expiry & Branch Transfers

sections.heading: Challenges of Multi-Location Inventory in Sri Lanka
sections.content: Companies running central warehouses in Kelaniya or Wattala alongside branch showrooms in Colombo, Kandy, and Galle face severe inventory discrepancies without a centralized ERP. Overstocking, stockouts of high-velocity items, and expired batches cause direct profit loss.

sections.heading: Automated Inter-Branch Stock Transfers & In-Transit Tracking
sections.content: Zoho Inventory tracks stock movements with multi-step dispatch and receipt confirmation. When a branch manager requests inventory, the system generates delivery challans, logs goods-in-transit, and updates stock valuation automatically upon destination receipt.

sections.heading: Automated Re-Order Triggers & Barcode Integration
sections.content: By defining minimum safety stock thresholds per warehouse, Zoho Inventory automatically generates draft Purchase Orders (POs) for approved vendors when stock levels deplete, preventing stockouts during peak retail seasons.

faq.q: Does Zoho Inventory support barcode scanning on mobile devices?
faq.a: Yes. Warehouse staff can use the Zoho Inventory mobile app or dedicated Bluetooth barcode scanners for picking, packing, receiving, and cycle counts.

faq.q: Can we track batch numbers and product expiry dates?
faq.a: Yes. Zoho Inventory supports FIFO/LIFO batch tracking with automated alerts for expiring perishable goods or pharmaceuticals.
